title: Kia Design - Designer
note: Designer I role in Kia's exterior design studio; internship and school project work can count toward experience; portfolio required.

facts.summary: Designer I position at the Kia Design Center in Irvine, focused on exterior design for concept and production vehicles.
facts.duties: Develop design proposals through sketches, renderings and 3D models, guide clay and digital sculptors, research trends and follow designs through development, with some travel to Korea.
facts.requirements: Degree or diploma in transportation or product design with an exterior focus; 2D and 3D visualization tools and digital modeling (Alias, SubD, Maya or Blender); valid driver's license; US work authorization. Studio experience is a plus, but internships and strong school work are accepted.
facts.apply: Apply on the Hyundai America careers site and upload a portfolio.
